chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 325: The Invisible Duel – Han Li vs. the Hidden Fiend
chapter_meta_description: A deadly, unseen battle erupts as Han Li faces a semi-demon that strikes from the shadows. The cost of a single miscalculation is shown in blood.
og_title: Han Li Fights an Invisible Enemy – RMJI Ch. 325
og_description: The half-demon Ice Fiend kills a sect sister in a brutal display of stealth, forcing Han Li to step up in a fight no one else can see.
twitter_description: A brutal invisible duel where only Han Li can see his enemy.

lore_anchors.definition: A one-time or limited-use magical treasure compressed into a talisman format, allowing a weaker cultivator to access its power. It is a high-cost, high-reward asset.
A battle fought without visual confirmation of the enemy, forcing reliance on sound, instinct, and magic tools that may fail.
